items.title: If all local rings are strictly henselian then etale and Zariski cohomology agree
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies etale and Zariski cohomology for a scheme whose local rings are all strictly henselian (statement lines 14204-14209). The proof (proof lines 14211-14225) computes the stalks of the higher direct images of the comparison morphism as the etale cohomology of the local rings, which vanishes in positive degrees by the strictly henselian hypothesis, so that the Leray spectral sequence degenerates. H2: one stalk computation plus one vanishing input, written out.
